entities.name: Brandis Thorn
entities.description: Pirate commander of the Dire Fleet of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan.

entities.name: Dire Fleet
entities.description: Feared pirate fleet commanded by Captain Thorn.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirate coalition of which the Dire Fleet is part.

entities.name: Gram Greddis
entities.description: Former captain of the Dire, from whom Thorn seized the wheel.

entities.name: Dire
entities.description: Thorn's first ship, flagship of the Dire Fleet.

entities.name: Diremore
entities.description: Ship Thorn seized and named, joining the Dire Fleet.

entities.name: Daphne Vail
entities.description: Former lookout of the Ugly Mug, made first mate of the Dire.

entities.name: Oscar Flinch
entities.description: Stowaway who knows the location of the golden city.

entities.name: Salty Dog
entities.description: Ship Thorn took over in a recent raid.

entities.name: Tormented Doubloon
entities.description: Flinch's old vessel, taken over by a snake-haired woman.

entities.name: Golden city
entities.description: Legendary city of treasures Thorn seeks.

events.summary: Thorn seizes the wheel of the Dire from former captain Gram Greddis and raids the nearest vessel, forcing its captain to walk the plank.
events.quote: Brandis himself boarded the ship and ordered its captain to walk the plank

events.summary: Daphne Vail, lookout of the Ugly Mug, stays silent as the Dire Fleet approaches, then asks Thorn for a promotion and becomes first mate of the Dire.
events.quote: Impressed, he made her first mate of the Dire , securing her loyalty forever.

events.summary: Thorn takes the Salty Dog and finds the stowaway Oscar Flinch halfway down the plank.
events.quote: he found someone already halfway down the plank: a stowaway named Oscar Flinch.

events.summary: Flinch tells of his old vessel being taken by a snake-haired woman seeking the golden city; intrigued, Thorn takes him aboard the Dire.
events.quote: Captain Thorn took Flinch back with him to the Dire

events.summary: Thorn leads an expedition into the heart of Ixalan using Flinch's knowledge of the golden city.
events.quote: Captain Thorn is using Flinch's piecemeal knowledge of the location of the golden city to lead an expedition into the heart of Ixalan.

relations.quote: Captain Brandis Thorn is a pirate commander of the Dire Fleet of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan .
Impressed, he made her first mate of the Dire

relations.note: Taken aboard to guide the expedition.
relations.quote: Captain Thorn took Flinch back with him to the Dire
